```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
window_label <- "2014 classes on"
# Last-school rule, 2014 classes on; a draftee counts once per coach.
pairs <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", 2014L) |>
  filter(group %in% position_group_levels()) |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, group)
totals <- pairs |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, name = "n_total", sort = TRUE)
top_n <- 8L
top8 <- slice_head(totals, n = top_n)
# Pooled mix over every head coach, the baseline the coaches are read against.
baseline <- pairs |>
  count(group, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), coach_name = "All head coaches")
group_order <- baseline |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  pull(group)
mix <- pairs |>
  inner_join(select(top8, coach_id), by = "coach_id") |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, group, name = "n") |>
  left_join(top8, by = c("coach_id", "coach_name")) |>
  mutate(share = n / n_total) |>
  select(coach_id, coach_name, group, n, n_total, share)
# The pooled bar sits on top; coaches follow in count order.
bars <- bind_rows(
  mix,
  baseline |>
    transmute(
      coach_id = NA_integer_,
      coach_name,
      group,
      n,
      n_total = sum(n),
      share
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    coach_name = factor(
      coach_name,
      c(rev(top8$coach_name), "All head coaches")
    ),
    group = factor(group, group_order)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(bars, aes(share, coach_name, fill = group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %d of %d draftees are %s (%.0f%%)",
        coach_name, n, n_total, tolower(as.character(group)), 100 * share
      ),
      data_id = paste(coach_name, group)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette()) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "Which position groups do the top coaches' draftees come from?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Share of each coach's draftees by position group, ",
      window_label,
      "; top ",
      top_n,
      " coaches against all head coaches"
    ),
    x = "Share of the coach's draftees",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE))

card_thumbnail(p, "top-coaches-position-mix", release = release, height = 7.5)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 9)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-count
p_count <- ggplot(mix, aes(n, coach_name, fill = group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d %s draftees", coach_name, n, tolower(as.character(group))),
      data_id = paste(coach_name, group)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette()) +
  labs(
    title = "The same top coaches' draftee counts by position group",
    subtitle = paste0("Draftee-coach pairs, the top ", top_n, " coaches with the most"),
    x = "Draftee-coach pairs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Last-school rule, 2014 classes on. Hover a segment for the coach and group."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_count, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
